author: Whitney Feldhusen
text: So quick to respond and easy to work with. Usually able to come out same day you call! Couldn't be happier with their service.

author: RJ Stark
text: I’ve been using their services for years. Just a simple phone call and a truck comes out, pumps the septic and they take care of all the paperwork. Super easy.

author: Jodi Stehli-Oblamski
text: Always so quick to get the job done. Love that I just have to send a quick text to let them know to come out and my son loves when they show up!

author: dawn taylor
text: Schulteis is always wonderful to deal with!  They are always pleasant, and are really quick to come out even though I’m sure they are busy every day.  If you need to let them know of any issue with the property the driver will call you personally and talk to you, that’s wonderful customer service!

author: Azingers
text:
Luke from Rural Sanitation walked me through the whole process and explained the system to me. I could tell he was knowledgeable and honest. He was easy to talk with and answered all my questions, he did the job well, and cleaned up before he left.
Chris returned my initial call promptly and made scheduling easy.
There is no reason I’d go anywhere else.
